          About this item

          • 【IPX8 Waterproof Rating】The fully enclosed design is discreet and the airtag is not exposed to view. Not only is it fully enclosed, but it also has a silicone gasket on the inside and is IPX8 rated. The length of the cable allows you to secure it to a suitcase handle that's about 1-3/4 inches wide, and the total length of the stand (including the cable length) is about 3.85 inches.
          • 【Easy Installation】Includes a hex key. Comfort grip handles are designed for maximum torque with ultimate comfort and grip. Installing or replacing airtag batteries is effortless! Unlike other mini hex key.
          • 【Versatile Use】With the built-in steel cable, you can securely attach your AirTag to a variety of items such as keychains, backpacks, pets, bicycles, or luggage. Easy to keep track of your valuables anywhere!
          • 【Protecting Your Air Tag】Made from a hard PC material+ ABS that is impact resistant and durable. It provides excellent protection against drops and scratches without hindering its signal transmission.
          • 【Package Included 】You'll receive 4 Pack Keychain Holder for AirTag with 1 hexagon socket (AIRTAG NOT INCLUDED).

              Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.
